findings.message: 1 headline(s) switch typeface or to italic mid-line (the "one italic serif word" move).
findings.fix: Set the whole headline in one face. Emphasis comes from the words.

findings.message: 5 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "ỨNG DỤNG DÀNH CHO CÁC CẶP ĐÔI" (pill) above "Có những ngày bình thường, chỉ muốn giữ "; "Kết nối" (pill) above "Một lời mời, hai người có nhau."; "Mood Check-in" (pill) above "Gọi tên cảm xúc, hiểu nhau hơn."; "Bắt đầu từ những điều nhỏ." above "0đ"; "Thêm không gian cho chuyện hai mình." above "49.000đ"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: 1 tiny uppercase letter-spaced label(s): "ỨNG DỤNG DÀNH CHO CÁC CẶP ĐÔI"
findings.fix: Prefer sentence case at body size.

findings.message: 10 gradient fill(s): div.absolute.inset-0 → radial-gradient(circle at 20% 15%, color(srgb 1 0.882353 0.72549 / 0.157059), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 70%) | div.absolute.inset-0 → radial-gradient(circle at 80% 10%, color(srgb 1 0.882353 0.72549 / 0.122157), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 75%) | div.pointer-events-none.absolute → linear-gradient(color(srgb 1 0.882353 0.72549 / 0.244314) 0%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 100%)
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 5 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: p.hero-eyebrow → rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85) 0px 1px 0px 0px inset, rgba(107, 70, 53, 0.06) 0px -1p | a.hero-primary-cta → rgba(255, 252, 248, 0.35) 0px 1px 0px 0px inset, rgba(174, 104, 57, 0.2) 0px 6px | a.hero-secondary-cta → rgba(107, 70, 53, 0.08) 0px 3px 12px 0px
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: 3 text-shadow(s).
findings.fix: Remove; fix legibility with a scrim or a different crop.

findings.message: Buttons with gradient fill and shadow/glow.
findings.fix: Flat fill, one colour.

findings.message: 1 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): div.footer-bottom 1065px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

findings.message: 4 boxes drawn with a 1px outline.
findings.fix: Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.

findings.message: 4 backdrop-blur surfaces.
findings.fix: One blurred sticky bar at most; glass cards are a tell.

findings.message: Cream + terracotta palette (page background #f2ede6, section #f2ede6, text #ac603d).
findings.fix: Re-draw the palette from the library. This pairing reads as an assistant brand, not yours.

findings.message: Low-contrast text: "Mood Check-in" 4:1 needs 4.5:1
findings.fix: Darken or lighten the text colour.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: 2 text block(s) under 13px.
findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: A section keeps its content on one side and leaves 709px of the width empty: "Bạn hỏi, Flamee trả lời.".
findings.fix: Fill the other side with what the section has (its picture, a second column, the figure), or defend the void in one sentence.

findings.message: 1 section(s) have content at both edges and 2101px of nothing between: "Ngày nào cũng có nhau."
findings.fix: Bring the two parts together on the grid, or put the picture or figure of the section in the middle. An empty middle third reads as a hole, the same as an empty half.

findings.message: The h1 is 31px ("Có những ngày bình thường, chỉ muốn giữ cùng bạn.").
findings.fix: Set the title at display size, or make the large text of the first screen the h1.

findings.message: 1 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 390px: "Có những ngày bình thường, chỉ muốn giữ cùng bạn" → 3 lines (10 words, 33.9px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 24px or less.

findings.message: Large text lies under another element at some scroll position: "49.000đ" (screen 6, 25% hidden)
findings.fix: Nothing may sit on top of a headline or statement. Move the picture, shorten the pinned run, or raise the text above it (z-index) and give it a ground.
